title: Advanced Packaging Warpage Modeling with DeepONet-Based Operator Learning
problem: Warpage caused by manufacturing thermal processes significantly impacts advanced packaging yield; FEM-based numerical simulations are time-consuming due to mesh generation and large matrix-solving requirements.
motivation: Faster warpage analysis accelerates packaging optimization and improves time-to-market for advanced packages.
method: Physics-informed operator learning framework using DeepONets for warpage surrogate model; enables rapid prediction of warpage effects without expensive FEM simulations.
key_novelty: DeepONet-based physics-informed operator learning for automated warpage surrogate model generation.
contributions: Physics-informed operator learning framework for warpage prediction
Training methodology for DeepONet-based surrogate models
Rapid warpage analysis tool reducing simulation time
limitations: Warpage prediction only; does not address other packaging effects or multi-physics interactions.
